title: Carla D.:
title_short: Carla D. · We can work together
headline: Math does not have to be sitting in silence alone. With Math Hoops it is a team, a buzzer beater and a new friend made that same day.
story: Carla is a big sports fan. Her best line is about math itself: it does not have to be you sitting in silence doing problems alone. “It's like we can work together.”
Then the proof: 10 seconds on the clock, she spins, three points, they win. And she met a new friend that same day. Her last line is the ask.

Loops: L1 “What does math feel like instead?” opens at 0:00 and closes at 0:07 (“we can work together”). L2 “What happened with 10 seconds left?” opens at 0:07 and closes at 0:17. Stakes: math alone, in silence.
do: Open on “math doesn't just have to be you sit in silence” with the hook text already on screen.
Pop <q>10 seconds</q> as she says it, over the scoreboard.
Put <q>I made new friends.</q> as top text before the friend story.
End on “It's the best thing in the world”, then the Donate end card.
Captions spell her name Carla if it appears (the transcript writes Karla).
dont: Do not use “compete against other students from different regions”: it is about a trip, not this day.
Do not use the school name the student says at the start.
No logo, name or fade at 0:00.
No end-of-year campaign words on the end card.

-14 LUFS integrated, -1 dBTP peak. Music always under the voice.
